output.explanation: Expanded domain because its controller snapshot and per-context history hide substantial composition. The central diagram now separates controller-owned state and operations from the shared history service and runtime revision registry. Two peripherals expand ControllerSnapshot and CanvasHistory ownership, with explicit append/restore relationships between them. Left workspace, sessions, surfaces and backend unchanged; their existing edges are preserved, with moved domain endpoints reattached. Checked the pinned checkout without modifying it. Corrected SelectionState: items can contain captured region data, while menu focus and pane presentation remain separate. Also clarified that transient updates need not append history, resolved documents differ from stored composition/bindings, and history reset/adopt create checkpoints rather than simply replace history.

DefaultCanvasHistoryService: editing-context storage
core/diagrams/{canvasHistoryService,canvasHistory,canvasCheckpointRecords}.ts
|
`-- contexts: WeakMap keyed by runtime CanvasEditingContext object
    `-- CanvasHistory per handle
        |-- CanvasHistoryRecord
        |   |-- Context ID, baseline/head IDs, past/future navigation stacks
        |   |-- snapshots: checkpoint ID -> StoredCanvasSnapshot
        |   |   |-- CanvasDocument: composition, edges, sections and annotations
        |   |   |-- diagramBindings: content ID -> immutable revision ID
        |   |   |-- view: separately restored MappingCanvasState for these controllers
        |   |   `-- Parent/transaction IDs, node origins and legacy unresolved anchors
        |   |-- diagramRevisions: retained revision table + optional ancestry boundary
        |   `-- canvasViews: named recordings and generation candidates, outside undo
        |-- DiagramRevisionEditor
        |   `-- Retained revision table + current-head binding resolver -> resolve/merge
        |-- Validated-checkpoint set, incremental change log and checkpoint encoder
        |-- append(document, view)
        |   |-- Validate scene, edges, jumps, contexts and presentation settings
        |   |-- -> shared registry: assert issued revisions; retain dependencies
        |   `-- Separate composition/bindings/view; update head and change log
        |-- document(checkpointId)
        |   `-- Resolve bindings -> working document; validate checkpoint on demand
        |-- navigate / reset
        |   `-- Navigate restores head; reset appends baseline; service guards transfers
        |-- fork(view) / adopt(record)
        |   `-- Fork: new context/navigation; adopt: proposed head as one new checkpoint
        |-- Saved-view and generation operations
        |   `-- Pin checkpoints and candidate histories within canvasViews
        `-- persistenceChanges(since)
            |-- Header + changed checkpoints/revisions + encoded storage records
            `-- -> controller -> WorkspacePersistence (durability is external)
